verdict.rationale: Stripe Terminal docs explicitly support a locations-and-zones model for managing readers across multiple physical sites, with readers registered to specific locations and manageable/monitorable from the Dashboard (docs-4, docs-13, docs-20, docs-32). However, evidence does not show per-location settings customization or per-location reporting breakdowns — only a general unified Dashboard for in-person/online payments (docs-10, docs-17). Missing for 10: explicit per-location settings configuration, per-location reporting/analytics views, and independent/hands-on confirmation of multi-location fleet management at scale.
